remarks: Welcome to 185 Lake Street, a charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath home ideally located in the Village of Hamburg. This inviting property offers a great combination of character, functionality, and recent updates. Enjoy the additional living and entertaining space provided by the enclosed front porch and spacious enclosed rear porch, perfect for relaxing, enjoying your morning coffee, or gathering with friends and family. The fully fenced backyard provides a private outdoor space, while the detached 2-car garage offers plenty of room for parking, storage, or hobbies. Major updates provide added peace of mind, including a roof replaced in 2017, forced-air furnace installed in 2017, and hot water tank replaced in 2024—all less than 10 years old. With three bedrooms, a full bath, multiple enclosed porch areas, a detached garage, and a fully fenced yard, 185 Lake Street offers a wonderful opportunity to own a home in the heart of the Village of Hamburg. Don't miss the chance to make this well-located property your own!
